meta.title: Official Sources Registry

data.name: Saudi Open Data Platform
documentation_sections: Machine-readable government datasets (CSV, XLS, JSON, XML)
Open data API access and dataset licensing
National open data catalogue under Vision 2030
data.last_verified: [PLACEHOLDER — date of last verification not yet recorded]
data.notes: Primary source for machine-readable Saudi government datasets. Operated by SDAIA (Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority) under the national open data strategy aligned with Vision 2030. Contains 11,000+ datasets from 289+ government entities in CSV, XLS, JSON, and XML formats. Check this platform before secondary sources when looking for machine-readable fee schedules, sector statistics, or regulatory data.
